blocks.text:
Open or close the phone and the screen folds with it: frosted glass on the half that is moving, and your cover screen waiting on the inner one, following the hinge as it turns.

Pick a Style on Duet's page in Settings › Tweaks: iPhone Duo, Duo, Classic Glass, Deep, Subtle or Minimal. Plays When chooses opening, closing or both, and Frost, Shade and Tilt tune the glass beside Intensity and the live preview. A package can also set Duet's look, and an update only changes what its new version changes, never what you already set yourself.

It stays calm when it should: Reduce Motion turns it off, and nothing in it flashes.

Styles use code from Duo Fold Live by joeconsorti and contributors, hingewave by Ant-lib and FoldFX by Gary Keeler, all MIT, credited under Settings › Credits. Inspired by Duo Open.

items: Six styles, from iPhone Duo to Minimal
Plays when opening, closing or both
Frost, Shade and Tilt sliders, with a live preview

entries.notes: Duet becomes a package in the Folio Market. The fold animation itself has shipped with Folio since 0.6.8.
